info.name: HV TDP Stainz CMS
info.description:
Public read API of the HV TDP Stainz website (Strapi 5). Pick the environment `HV TDP CMS – local` or `HV TDP CMS – production`.

Collections are paged (max. 100 per page); the website loads all pages. Images come with `populate` and contain `url` plus `formats` (thumbnail, small, medium, large).

item.name: Documents
item.description: Downloads of the documents page (`migrate-to-strapi.sh documents`). Protected documents are delivered only by `POST /api/documents/:documentId/download` with the members' password; the public list does not contain their files.

request.description: All documents in display order. Protected documents come without `file`; they are only available via the download endpoint. Run this first: it stores `publicDocumentId` and `protectedDocumentId` for the download requests.

exec: pm.test('Documents with category, file and protected flag', () => {
pm.test('Only public documents expose their file', () => {
if (doc.protected) pm.expect(doc.file, `${doc.title} must not expose its file`).to.be.null;
else pm.expect(doc.file && doc.file.mime, `${doc.title} needs a PDF`).to.eql('application/pdf');
// Used by the download requests below.

request.description: Public documents need no password.
Protected document with the members' password (`documentsPassword` in the environment; the server compares it with DOCUMENTS_PASSWORD). Not cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`).
Must be refused with 401. After 10 failed attempts per IP the endpoint answers 429 for 15 minutes.

exec: pm.test('Refused with 401 (or 429 after too many attempts)', () => pm.expect([401, 429]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Pages
item.description: Hallenturnier page with its registration and the Advent calendars (`migrate-to-strapi.sh pages`). The registration request stores an entry and sends two mails (to the club and the registrant): use it locally only.

request.description: The current tournament with image, prizes and the link to last year's album.

Registers a team: 200, or 400 (invalid input), 409 (registration closed), 429 (more than 5 per hour from one IP). Stores the registration and sends the club mail and the confirmation mail (without SMTP_HOST they are only logged).
The server validates like the form does.
Registrations contain personal data: only visible in the admin.
